name: CozyMeow
detailed_description:
“Cozy Meow” — When a Ragdoll Cat Moves into Your Screen, Every Frame Becomes Touchable, Healing Time

[A Desktop World of Laziness and Surprise]
When a blue-eyed ragdoll cat leaps into your screen—casting a fishing line beside your documents, gently rolling a crystal ball across your desktop—your workday is redefined! This immersive desktop pet game perfectly blends soothing companionship with light-weight utility, letting you harvest purring little joys amid the busy grind.

✨ Key Gameplay Highlights ✨
🐾 Dynamic Fishing System
Watch Meow casually sway a rod at the edge of your screen, fishing in different scenes. Sell your catch for Meow Coins to unlock limited cursor skins, adorable wallpapers, and even hidden mini-game Easter eggs!

🔮 Magical Tarot Divination
“Ding!”—see your fortune for the day as the cat master rubs a crystal ball. With paws wrapped around glowing orb, stardust bursts forth and tarot cards float amid smoky effects, delivering your personalized fortune slip.

🎵 Desktop Music Maestro
Twenty-one floating “scale fish” hover on your desktop—click them to compose original melodies. Instantly turn your workspace into a music studio! Spanning three octaves, you can save custom arrangements for later.

⏳ Meow-Style Efficiency Butler
Enter your work hours and hourly wage, and Meow will count your earnings, show a countdown to clock-out, and remind you to pack up when it’s time to dash!

🎁 Meow Gacha Machine
Click to shake the machine, spin the knob, and release a capsule! Beyond collectibles, these gacha items can be used in various mini-games and surprises.

Join over 100,000 Cloud-Based “Poop-Scoopers” and Experience:

  • Real-time interactive, healing companionship (supports “always on top” or minimized background mode)

  • 200+ collectible decorations and Easter eggs

  • Daily updated fortune slips and seasonal limited-time events

  • Focus mode integration with Pomodoro timer

Bring home this fluffy companion who fishes, tells fortunes, composes music, and boosts your productivity! Windows platform support, under 300 MB system footprint—turn your desktop from dull to delight, frame by frame.

✨ “With Meow by your side, even the most ordinary workday can sparkle.” ✨
